# Animal Pedia

> > A comprehensive wildlife encyclopedia covering animal classification, species guides, and habitat information with expert contributions from Ph.D. Truong Nguyen, Jessica Pham, and Ph.D. Hoàng Xuân Quang.

Animal Pedia provides detailed taxonomic information, behavioral profiles, and conservation status for reptiles, amphibians, fish, and other animal groups. The site features both broad reference directories organized by class and in-depth species guides covering habitat, diet, reproduction, and unique adaptations.

## Animal Classification & Taxonomy

- [Introduction to Animal Classification: A Comprehensive Guide](https://animal-pedia.org/blog/animal-classification): Taxonomy guide: Linnaeus system, hierarchical ranks, scientific naming
- [Amphibians: Species Guide, Life Cycles and Adaptations](https://animal-pedia.org/amphibians): Amphibia class overview: metamorphosis, dual-life adaptations, ecology

## Reptile Directories

- [Snakes - Animal Pedia](https://animal-pedia.org/browse/reptiles/snakes): Snake directory featuring Serpentes species profiles and classifications
- [Crocodilia - Animal Pedia](https://animal-pedia.org/browse/reptiles/crocodilia): Crocodilia directory: crocodiles, alligators, caimans, and gharials
- [Fishes - Animal Pedia](https://animal-pedia.org/browse/fish): Fish directory exploring Actinopterygii diversity and aquatic ecosystems

## Snake Species Guides

- [Vipers: Venomous Snakes, Habitat, Behavior & Conservation](https://animal-pedia.org/snakes/vipers): Viperidae family guide covering venomous species and conservation efforts
- [Eastern Hognose Snake: Complete Guide to Venomous Concerns, Characteristic & Habitat](https://animal-pedia.org/snakes/eastern-hognose-snakes): Complete guide to Heterodon platirhinos defensive behavior and habitat
- [Dragon Snake: Unique Defense Mechanism, Habitat & Behavior](https://animal-pedia.org/snakes/dragon-snake): Xenodermus javanicus defense mechanisms and Southeast Asian habitat

## Lizard Species Guides

- [Chameleons: Color-Changing Lizard, Facts, Habitat & Conservation](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/chameleons): Chameleon species guide covering color change, rotating eyes, and care tips
- [Marine Iguana: World's Only Ocean-Swimming Lizard, Habitat & Conservation](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/marine-iguanas): Amblyrhynchus cristatus: Galápagos endemic ocean-swimming lizard guide
- [Crocodile Monitor: Longest Lizard Species, Habitat & Conservation](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/crocodile-monitor): Guide to Varanus salvadorii, Papua New Guinea's massive tree-dwelling lizard
- [Perentie: Australia's Largest Lizard, Hunting Skills, Habitat & Behavior](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/perentie): Varanus giganteus: Australia's largest monitor lizard hunting and behavior
- [Galapagos Land Iguana: Facts, Cactus Diet, Habitat & Conservation](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/galapagos-land-iguana): Conolophus subcristatus cactus-eating iguana of Galapagos Islands
- [Jamaican Giant Anole: Caribbean's Largest Anole, Habitat, Behavior & Status](https://animal-pedia.org/lizard/jamaican-giant-anole): Caribbean's largest anole species Anolis garmani endemic to Jamaica

## Tortoise & Testudines Guides

- [Aldabra Giant Tortoise: Characteristics, Behavior, Habitat, and Reproduction Explained](https://animal-pedia.org/testudines/aldabra-giant-tortoise): Aldabrachelys gigantea ecosystem engineer in Seychelles habitats
- [Hermann's Tortoise: Domed Carapace, Habitat, Facts & Care Guide](https://animal-pedia.org/testudines/hermanns-tortoise): Testudo hermanni Mediterranean tortoise care and conservation guide

## Alphabetical Animal References

- [80+ Animals that start with H - Classified lists with Pictures and Fun facts](https://animal-pedia.org/animals-that-start-with-h): Alphabetical reference of 80+ animals starting with H by classification
- [135+ Animals that start with M - Classified lists with Pictures and Fun facts](https://animal-pedia.org/animals-that-start-with-m): Alphabetical reference of 135+ animals starting with M across all classes
- [50+ Animals that start with F - Classified lists with Pictures and Fun facts](https://animal-pedia.org/animals-that-start-with-f): Alphabetical reference of 50+ animals starting with F, sorted by class
